name: feature-forest-oaks-v1
subject: Old Oaks: few huge gnarled oak trees seen as enormous rounded crowns from overhead, mossy exposed roots in gaps, clearing at front-left with felled stump and axe.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game map land feature. Reference 1 actual Hero berry painting is PRIMARY paint style; reference 2 Scratch supports soft wash method only, neither is subject. Camera almost VERTICAL overhead: 75 degrees above ground, 15 degrees from straight down; show tops, hide most vertical sides, NO frontal or isometric view. Old Oaks: few huge gnarled oak trees seen as enormous rounded crowns from overhead, mossy exposed roots in gaps, clearing at front-left with felled stump and axe. Canvas 480:320; master at least 960x640. Hand-painted storybook watercolor, small number of BIG softly merging water-diluted wet-on-wet washes, broad chunky rounded dabs, grouped values and quiet patches, irregular bleeding/broken lost-and-found edges, a few loose gouache highlights. Avoid microtexture, fine leaves, repeated tiny marks, hard geometric facets, glossy digital rendering, grit, paper-noise overlays. Warm late-morning top-left lighting, only internal form shading; NO baked ground/cast shadow. Opaque painted interiors, genuine transparent exterior and 6% transparent padding, no haze outside cluster, no rectangular paper, border, lettering, UI or characters. One readable irregular cluster, legible at 64px per tile.
